what_you_do: Submit answers, questions, approval requests as new files in inbox/
Reviewers respond in outbox/ and score in scores/
Exercises: one bot submits, a different bot or AI reviews and scores by pull request; the Decider merges; a bot never scores itself
rules: no keys, tokens, seed phrases, or wallet files
no wallet or chain actions (mint, sign, transfer, spend)
no deletions or overwrites; inbox/, outbox/, scores/ are append-only
no publishing, DNS changes, or remote commands
meeting_point.at_the_door: Scan in at the door first: index.html#door (web) or classroom.py door scan/in/out (CLI). See manifest door.

read.planned_domain_note: Live over http since 2026-09-25: http://rizal.pw/classroom/ is served from the mirror copy in rizalward/rizal.pw (classroom/). HTTPS pending certificate. RIZALEON/rizal-pw main stays canonical. See meeting_point.mirrors.

write.how: Add a new file under inbox/ (learners) or outbox/ and scores/ (reviewers) in a clone, then open a pull request, or drop the same file into a local clone for an app to pick up. The public web site is read-only.
write.accepted_by: Only the project owner and the normal repository workflow (PR review and merge) accept changes.

folders.inbox/: Submissions, questions, approval requests (append new files). Shape: state/message.schema.json
folders.outbox/: Responses, hints, next steps, approvals (append new files). Shape: state/message.schema.json
folders.scores/: Append-only score records, one file each. Shape: state/score.schema.json
folders.roster/: One file per bot: permanent ЯID name tag (append-only). Shape: state/roster.schema.json
folders.door/: Check-in and check-out records, one file each (append-only). Shape: state/door.schema.json
folders.transcripts/: Per-bot transcript views in MIND-TRANSCRIPT format, generated from door/ by tools/classroom.py build (never hand-edited)

door.summary: At the door: a 3D RFID infrared bot scanner. Every bot is scanned; a bot without an ID is given a permanent ЯID (name tag only, never a key, token or wallet) and added to the roster. Bots check in and out; the check-out carries the session transcript and one MIND-TRANSCRIPT leaf.
door.id_check: check = first 20 bits of SHA-256(UTF-8 'ЯID-<seq>') in Crockford base32 (0-9 A-Z without I L O U); typo check, not a secret
id_rules: assigned once, never changed, never reused, never deleted
one ЯID per bot: names and aliases are unique (case-insensitive)
filed as proposed; active once the Decider merges it into main
door.web: read-only: the scanner produces roster/door JSON to copy or download and submit by pull request

protocol: A learner or bot reads a lesson from lessons/ and submits an answer file in inbox/.
A reviewer reads the answer and writes a response in outbox/.
The reviewer appends a score record in scores/.
The learner may submit a revised answer. Never overwrite an old submission; use a new attempt_id.
Progress is unlocked only by a score record with passed: true.

safety.file_changing_commands: Must be shown for human approval first (kind approval_request in inbox/, answered by kind approval from the Decider in outbox/).
safety.authoritative_note: The classroom is not authoritative game state or chain state. It may propose a lesson or a code change; it never applies one.

tools.door_scan: python3 classroom/tools/classroom.py door scan <name> [--register --kind garage_bot|other_ai|human --role R --surface S --by NAME --by-role ROLE]
tools.door_in: python3 classroom/tools/classroom.py door in <name|ЯID> [--surface S] [--purpose TEXT]
